alate: Head capsule light chestnut brown; labrum, postclypeus, postmentum and femora nearly yellowish brown; pronotum and tibiae light yellowish brown; antennae brownish. Head capsule circular and slightly elongate; fontanelle dot-like, 0.48 mm from the anterior margin of the frons. In profile the vertex is slightly arched, the anterior margin of the postclypeus distinctly projecting, almost level with the vertex and higher than the ocelli. Compound eyes nearly circular, protrusion 4%, short diameter about equal to the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli oval; short diameter greater than the ocellus–compound eye distance. Antennae 16–17 segments. Pronotum about 1.43 times as wide as long, anterior margin with a distinct broad V-shaped incision in the middle, posterior margin nearly straight with an indistinct incision. Forewing 7.34–7.8 mm long, 1.83–2.17 mm wide; hindwing 6.73–7.34 mm long, 1.75–1.99 mm wide; forewing Cu vein with about 14 branches.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
